text:
Sarah L: Heads-up — release cutoff in ~3h. Need a quick version bump PR, final changelog nudge, and a green CI before cutoff. Can folks confirm blockers?
Omar R: I can open the bump PR in ~20m. still investigating one flaky e2e on ubuntu-20.04 though.
Kevin M: thanks Omar. FYI I left a comment on the changelog draft — missing the breaking note for config parsing. cc @Sarah L
Sarah L: good catch @Kevin M — we need that in changelog otherwise infra will flag it. Omar, do we have a safe rollback plan if the e2e keeps failing?
Omar R: plan A: quarantine the test (test id: tests/e2e/large_payload) and proceed. Plan B: revert the last dependency bump (dep-ui 2.4.1 -> 2.3.9) if quarantine isn't acceptable. I'd prefer quarantine + note in changelog.
ci-bot: build/2249501221 started for pr #4528 (version-bump-2.7.0)
QA Bot: flake-detection: tests/e2e/large_payload flagged as flaky (5 failures in last 30 runs)
Kevin M: quarantine sounds fine to me if we mark it in the release notes. That test has been noisy.
Alice J: pinging release docs owners — do we have a template entry for quarantined tests? if not I'll add one.
Sarah L: please add template entry. Also add an explicit rollback step in the runbook: revert dep-ui if post-rollout errors > 1% for 10m.
Omar R: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4528 — includes version bump and changelog stub. Triggered CI.
ci-bot: build/2249501221 failed: e2e-ubuntu-20.04 (tests/e2e/large_payload) - see logs: https://ci.internal/logs/2249501221
Omar R: extracting logs now, running locally with `./scripts/run_e2e.sh --filter large_payload`
Kevin M: if you need a quick patch, try pinning the cURL timeout in that test — it's been timing out on CI load.
Omar R: good call, trying that in a hotfix branch.
Alice J: changelog update ready at draft: https://gist.github.com/alice/changelog-2.7.0 — added quarantined-test note and rollback steps.
Sarah L: great. final checklist for cutoff: 1) bump PR merged, 2) changelog entry present, 3) CI green on main, or quarantine + note. Who can watch the merge window at T-30m?
Kevin M: I can watch the merge window and handle quick reverts.
Omar R: I'll push the small cURL timeout tweak, re-run CI, and comment on the PR.
ci-bot: build/2249501299 started for branch hotfix/ci-timeout-fix
ci-bot: build/2249501299 passed — all checks green
Omar R: pushed fix and updated PR with test workaround. ready for merge pending approvals.
Sarah L: ok lets merge once approvals done. tagging @release-ops to be aware of the quarantine note. :memo: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
QA Bot: post-merge watch scheduled for 60m starting at 2249501600
Kevin M: merged at T-45m. monitoring.
Sarah L: thanks all — if any regressions in the next hour we follow the rollback step. otherwise cut the release. :rocket:
